semantics: Complete ordered first-parent landing changes in each preserved baseline-to-endpoint range. For every included commit, files and pointer changes are compared with its first parent, including merge landings. Merged sidebranch commits are identified as evidence and are not counted again. Classification describes commits, not proof that a pointer update was behavior-required. Full changed-file sets qualify attribution; Git object IDs remain authoritative.

classification_definitions.story-implementation-carried: Commit includes implementation of the named story family (including its sibling removal artifact), possibly mixed with broader work, and dependency pointers.
classification_definitions.story-metadata-carried: Commit touches this story artifact or review metadata but no runtime source/tests; dependency pointers remain separately identified.
classification_definitions.independent-range-work: Commit implements dependency/tooling or another story without changing this story artifact. Shared source paths alone do not establish ownership.
